Join us on 10–12 September, 2026
at NDSM Loods & Xebia!
We are thrilled to announce the next edition of PyData Amsterdam! This year, the conference will take place on 10 & 11 September 2026 at the iconic NDSM Loods, one of Amsterdam’s most unique industrial venues, with the Tutorial Day on 12 September, 2026 hosted at Xebia’s Amsterdam office. PyData Amsterdam is a conference for the international community of those working in AI, data science, data engineering, or open-source tools. This is a unique opportunity to connect with the community and learn from industry experts.
Over the span of 3 days, attendees will participate in workshops, attend live keynote sessions and talks. The global PyData network promotes discussion of best practices, new approaches, and emerging technologies for data management, processing, analytics, and visualization. PyData communities approach data science using many languages, including (but not limited to) Python, Julia, and R.
Join us for three days of inspiring talks, workshops, knowledge sharing, and plenty of opportunities to connect with like-minded people in the Python and Data community!
If you have questions about the conference please visit the FAQ page or send us an email at AMSTERDAM@PYDATA.ORG.
Conference Location -10 & 11 September 2026
NDSM-Plein 90C, 1033 WB Amsterdam
Tutorial Day Location -12 September 2026
Wibautstraat 200, 1091 TJ Amsterdam

Be part of the PyData Amsterdam community on September 10–12, 2026 — an opportunity to engage, network, and collaborate with peers across the Python data ecosystem. The conference attracts a diverse audience that includes CTOs, leaders in technology and data, senior developers, and passionate data enthusiasts from around the world.
Sponsoring the event provides direct access to this highly engaged community and a platform to showcase your organization’s products, services, and career opportunities. Experience a professionally organized conference led by a neutral nonprofit, where the program and content are curated by the community itself.
You also give back to the open source community. NumFOCUS reinvests profits from our events to directly support NumFOCUS' sponsored projects such as Pandas, Numpy, Matplotlib and many more.
If you’re interested to sponsor PyData Amsterdam, or if you have any further questions, please reach out to us at amsterdam@pydata.org.

PD Amsterdam 2025 Impressions
Insightful talks, hands-on tutorials, and exceptional networking opportunities
PyData Amsterdam 2025 was a 3-day conference, hosted in de Kromhouthal and TNW city (tutorial day), for an international community of users and developers of data analysis tools, to share ideas and learn from each other. Last year, we celebrated the 10-year anniversary of PyData Amsterdam 24-26 September.

PyData Amsterdam
Amsterdam has a vibrant, growing community of Python and data enthusiasts. PyData Amsterdam brings together this community and provides a forum for users and developers of open source data analysis tools to share ideas and learn from each other, through regular meetups and a yearly conference. Our events promote discussion of best practices, new approaches, and emerging technologies for data management, processing, analytics, and visualization.
